info.name: MessMate API
info.description:
# MessMate API — puro collection

Mess management backend. Express 5 + Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL.

## Shuru korar niyom (ei order-e)

1. **Server chalu koro** — `pnpm dev` (BackEnd folder-e)
2. **Seed data** — `pnpm seed` (na korle demo account gulo thakbe na)
3. `00 · Health → Ready check` — DB connect ache kina
4. `01 · Auth → Login — Owner` ⭐ — token auto-save hobe
5. `01 · Auth → Me` ⭐ — `messId` ar `membershipId` auto-save hobe
6. `07 · Periods → List periods` ⭐ — `periodId` auto-save hobe
7. Erpor je kono folder chalao

**Ei tinta star-marked request na chalale baki gulo `{{messId}}` khali peye fail korbe.**

## "Run collection" korle

Folder `00` theke `11` porjonto **ek sathe chalano jay** — role bodlanor request gulo (`↪ Login as ...`) folder-er bhitorei ache ar shesh-e Owner-e fire ase.

**Kintu `12 · Destructive` folder ta bad dao** — oita password bodlay ar ownership transfer kore. Oigulo hate kore, bujhe chalao.

**Ekta jinish mathay rakho:** `07 · Periods` folder mash **close** kore, tarpor **reopen** kore. Puro run-er por mash ta REOPENED obosthay thakbe — chaile abar `CLOSE month` chaliye bondho kore dao.

## Auto-save variable

Hate kore id copy-paste korte hobe na — test script gulo nijei save kore:
`accessToken`, `userId`, `messId`, `membershipId`, `periodId`, `targetMembershipId`, `expenseId`, `depositId`, `inviteCode`, `invitationId`

Date gulo-o auto: `{{today}}`, `{{tomorrow}}`, `{{plus2}}`, `{{plus3}}`, `{{farFuture}}`, `{{currentMonth}}` — Dhaka timezone dhore.

## Seed account (password shob gulor: `Messmate123`)

| Role | Email | Ki korte pare |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OWNER | owner@messmate.test | Sob kichu — reopen, role change, ownership transfer |
| MANAGER | manager@messmate.test | Expense, deposit, member, month close. Reopen **na** |
| ACCOUNTANT | accountant@messmate.test | Expense, deposit, report, preview. Close **na** |
| COOK | cook@messmate.test | Shudhu meal count. Kono taka **na** |
| MEMBER | member1@messmate.test | Shudhu nijer meal/deposit/statement |

Invite code: `DEMO2026`

## Puro flow ek nojore

```
Login → Mess → Invite/Join → Meal entry → Expense → Deposit
  → Preview (hisheb dekho) → Close (statement toiri) → Statement
  → dorkar hole Reopen → thik koro → abar Close
```

## Response format

Success: `{ success: true, statusCode, message, data, meta? }`

Error: `{ success: false, statusCode, code, message, details?, requestId }`

## Status code-er mane

| Code | Mane |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Request-er gathon bhul (validation) |
| 401 | Login-i koro nai / token expired |
| 403 | Login ache, kintu ei kaj-er odhikar nei |
| 404 | Ei mess-er moddhe jinish ta nei (onno mess-er hoteo pare — ichchhe kore 404) |
| 409 | Conflict — duplicate, ba mash already closed |
| 422 | Business rule bhengeche (jemon reconciliation mismatch) |
| 429 | Rate limit |

item.name: 00 · Health
item.description: Server ar database beche ache kina — sob kaj shuru korar age ekbar chalao. Ei tinta route-e kono token lage na.

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Node process cholche kina bole.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Server on ache kina jante. Database down thakleo eta 200 debe.

**Expect:** `200` + `{ status: "ok", uptime: <seconds> }`

**Ki kore:** Database-e `SELECT 1` chaliye dekhe connection ache kina.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Deploy-er por, ba kono request-e 500 pele — problem ta app-e naki DB-te seta alada kore.

**Expect:** `200` + `{ status: "ready", database: "connected" }`. DB down hole `503`.

**Ki kore:** API-r naam, version ar useful path gulo return kore.

**Expect:** `200`

item.name: 01 · Auth
item.description:
Login, token ar password.

**⭐ "Login — Owner" ar "Me" — ei duita age chalao.** Token, messId ar membershipId auto-save hobe, tarpor baki sob folder kaj korbe.

Ei folder ta **order-safe**: puro folder run korle shesh-e tumi Owner hisebe logged in thakbe. Role bodlanor request gulo "11 · Security"-te, ar bipojjonok gulo "12 · Destructive"-e alada rakha ache.

Token duivabe jay: httpOnly cookie (Postman nijei rakhe) ar Bearer header (`{{accessToken}}`).

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Notun user account banay ar sathe sathe login kore dey (token feriye dey).

Email-e `{{$timestamp}}` ache, tai **proti bar notun account** toiri hobe — `409` ashbe na. Email ta `joinEmail` variable-e save hoy; "03 · Members"-er join flow eta use kore.

**Rules:**
- Password minimum 8 char, ekta boro hater + ekta choto hater + ekta digit
- Eki email diye abar dile `409`
- `phone` optional

**Cheshta koro:** password `abc` diye pathao — `400`, ar kon rule bhengeche seta `details`-e dekhabe.

**Expect:** `201`

exec: try { pm.environment.set("joinEmail", pm.response.json().data.user.email); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

**Important — rotation:** proti refresh-e purono session revoke hoye notun ekta toiri hoy. Tai **eki refresh token duibar use korle** system dhore ney token ta churi hoyeche, ar oi user-er **sob session revoke** kore dey.

**Cheshta koro:** eita duibar por por chalao — dwitiybar `401` ashbe, ar tumi logged out hoye jabe. Erpor abar login korte hobe.

item.name: 02 · Mess
item.description: Mess toiri ar settings. Mess banale tumi automatic OWNER hoye jao.

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Notun mess banay ar tomake OWNER banay — duitai ek transaction-e, tai owner chhara mess kokhono toiri hoy na.

**Field gulo:**
- `timezone` — cutoff ei timezone-e hisheb hoy (server-er ghori na)
- `mealCutoffTime` — ei somoy-er por member ajker meal bodlate parbe na
- `cutoffDaysAhead` — koto din samner meal set kora jabe (1 = shudhu kal)

**Expect:** `201` + mess object with auto-generated `slug`.

exec: try { pm.environment.set("newMessId", pm.response.json().data.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Tumi jo jo mess-e ache tar list, sathe tomar role ar active member count.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Frontend-er mess switcher-e.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Ekta mess-er details + member/period count.

**Security note:** onno karo mess-er valid id dile `404` ashbe — `403` na. Karon mess ta ache kina seta-o gopon rakha hoy.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Mess settings bodlay. Sob field optional — jeta pathabe shudhu seta bodlabe.

**Ke parbe:** OWNER ba MANAGER. Cook/Member cheshta korle `403`.

**Audit:** age-pore-r snapshot audit log-e jay — "10 · Audit Log" folder-e dekha jabe.

**Expect:** `200`

item.name: 03 · Members & Invitations
item.description: Member add kora, role bodlano, ownership transfer. Invite code diye join korano hoy — code ta **shudhu ekbar** dekha jay, database-e shudhu hash thake.

request.description:
**⭐ Join flow test korte age eita chalao.**

**Ki kore:** Invite code banay. Response-e plaintext `code` ase — **eibar-i sudhu**, database-e shudhu SHA-256 hash thake.

**Field gulo:**
- `role` — join kore ke ki role pabe. **OWNER dewa jabe na** (`400`) — ownership shudhu transfer diye jay
- `maxUses` — koyjon ei code use korte parbe

**Ke parbe:** OWNER / MANAGER.

**Expect:** `201`. Code ta auto-save hobe `inviteCode` variable-e.

**Ke parbe:** MANAGER+ (Accountant read korte pare). **MEMBER ba COOK cheshta korle `403`.**

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Kono member-er role bodlay.

**Ke parbe:** **shudhu OWNER**. Manager cheshta korleo `403`.

**Rule:** OWNER-er role ei route diye bodlano jabe na (`403`) — tar jonno "Transfer ownership" ache. Karon owner-ke demote korle mess-e kono owner thakbe na.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Member ke ACTIVE / INACTIVE / REMOVED kore.

**Parthokko:**
- `INACTIVE` — mess-e ache kintu notun meal/expense likhte parbe na; purono hisheb thake
- `REMOVED` — puropuri baad

**Guard:** kono OPEN month-e oi member-er meal entry thakle `REMOVED` block hoy (`422`) — karon tahole hisheb-er ekta angsho malikbihin hoye jay. Message-e bole INACTIVE koro ba age month close koro.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Uporer test-er por member ke abar ACTIVE kore dey.

**Keno dorkar:** INACTIVE member EQUAL expense-er bhag pay na. Restore na korle "05 · Expenses"-er EQUAL split-e ekjon kom porbe ar sonkhya gulo bujhte kothin hobe.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Invite code ta bondho kore dey — erpor keu use korte parbe na.

**Kokhon lagbe:** code kothao faash hoye gele.

**Note:** ei folder ta abar shuru theke chalale "Create invitation" notun code banabe, tai osubidha nei.

**Expect:** `200`

item.name: 04 · Meals
item.description:
Application-er sob cheye beshi byabohrito ongsho. Cutoff niyom mess-er **timezone** mene chole — server-er ghori na.

Cutoff rule ek line-e: member `aj` theke `aj + cutoffDaysAhead` din porjonto edit korte pare, ar `aj`-ke shudhu `mealCutoffTime` er age porjonto.

query.description: Kon date-er kotha jante chao (khali rakhle aj)

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Ekta date ekhon edit kora jabe kina, ar na gele keno — seta bole.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Frontend-e meal page-er upore banner dekhate ("aj rat 10ta porjonto somoy ache").

**Expect:** `200` + `{ editable, reason, mealCutoffTime, cutoffDaysAhead, timezone }`

**⭐ Ei API tai sob cheye beshi call hobe.**

**Ki kore:** Nijer ek diner meal set kore (upsert — thakle update, na thakle create).

**Quantity rules:**
- `0.5` step-e hote hobe — `0.7` dile `400`
- guest meal alada field-e, kintu total-e jog hoy
- `totalMealUnits` = breakfast + lunch + dinner + guest tinta

**URL-er date ta `{{tomorrow}}`** — collection-er pre-request script Dhaka time dhore auto set kore.

**Expect:** `200` + `totalMealUnits: "4.50"`

**Ki proman kore:** Member purono din-er meal bodlate pare na.

**Expect:** `403` + message: *"2026-01-05 is in the past. Ask a manager to override it."*

Eita bodlate hole "Manager override" API lagbe (niche ache).

item.name: Set my meal — too far ahead (403)

request.description:
**Ki proman kore:** `cutoffDaysAhead` er baire jawa jabe na. Default 1 — mane shudhu kal porjonto.

**Expect:** `403` + *"You can only set meals up to 1 day(s) ahead."*

**Note:** "02 · Mess"-e `cutoffDaysAhead: 2` set korle ei behaviour bodlabe.

**Ki proman kore:** Meal quantity 0.5 step-e hote hobe — UI-r stepper ja dey.

**Expect:** `400` + `details: [{ path: "body.lunch", message: "Meal quantity must be in steps of 0.5" }]`

**Ki kore:** Ek maser nijer sob meal entry + mot units + koydin khaoa hoyeche.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Meal calendar page-e.

**Expect:** `200` + `{ year, month, totalMealUnits, daysWithMeals, entries[] }`

**Ki kore:** Ek diner meal onek din-e copy kore — "same for 7 days" button-er jonno.

**Important:** je din gulo cutoff-er baire ba month closed, segulo **skip** hoy — chupchap fail hoy na. Response-e `applied[]` ar `skipped[]` duitai ase, `skipped`-e karon soho.

**`overwrite: false`** hole already entry thaka din gulo skip hobe.

**Expect:** `200`. `cutoffDaysAhead: 1` thakle beshirbhag din skip hobe — seta thik, response dekho.

**Ki kore:** Ek din-e kon member koto meal niyeche — sobar list.

**Ke parbe:** COOK ba tar upore. Sadharon MEMBER `403`.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Randhunir jonno shudhu total — koyta breakfast, lunch, dinner. **Kono taka nei.**

**Guest meal alada dekhay** (`guestTotal`), jate rannaghor jane matha-ganti member-er cheye beshi.

**Expect:** `200`

query.description: Kon maser — "07 · Periods" theke auto-save hoy

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Ek mase kon member koto meal unit niyeche.

**Keno guruttopurno:** ei number tai meal rate-er bhagfol — `mealRate = totalFoodExpense / totalMealUnits`.

**⚠️ Age "07 · Periods → List periods" chalao**, na hole `periodId` khali thakbe.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Manager onno member-er meal bodlate pare, **cutoff mene na cholei**.

**Kintu duita jinish bandha:**
1. `reason` baddhotamulok — chhara pathale `400`
2. Month **closed** hole tao block hoy — override cutoff bypass kore, closed month na

**Audit:** age-pore-r puro snapshot audit log-e jay, karon eta onner hisheb bodlacche.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki proman kore:** Reason chhara override hoy na — na hole audit log-e "keno bodlano holo" thakbe na.

**Expect:** `400` + `details[0].path = "body.reason"`

item.name: 05 · Expenses
item.description:
**Sob cheye guruttopurno niyom:** khabar/bazar-er kharcha meal rate-e jay; bhara/bidyut/internet meal rate-e **kokhono** meshe na — segulo alada rule-e bhag hoy.

Char rokom allocation:
- `MEAL_BASED` — meal onujayi (shudhu FOOD)
- `EQUAL` — sobar moddhe soman
- `CUSTOM` — tumi nijei bhag likhe dao (ghor-bhittik bhara)
- `MEMBER_SPECIFIC` — shudhu ek/koyekjon-er (byaktigato kenakata)

request.description:
**⭐ Ei type-tai meal rate toiri kore.**

**Ki kore:** Bazar-er kharcha likhe rakhe. Ekhane **kono share toiri hoy na** — karon meal onujayi bhag mash close-er somoy hobe, jokhon mot meal unit jana jabe.

**Amount string kore pathao** (`"7500.00"`) — JS-er float rounding jate taka-poisay na dhoke.

**Expect:** `201`, `shares: []`

exec:
pm.collectionVariables.set("expenseId", pm.response.json().data.id);
try { pm.environment.set("expenseId", pm.response.json().data.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Sob ACTIVE member-er moddhe soman bhag kore — server nijei share row banay.

**Poisa-perfect:** 1000 taka 3 jon-e bhag korle 333.34 + 333.33 + 333.33 — jog korle thik 1000. Naive division-e 999.99 hoto.

**`excludeMembershipIds`** diye kauke baad dewa jay (jemon puro mash bairе chilo).

**Expect:** `201` + `shares[]` bhorti

**Ki kore:** Tumi nije bhag likhe dao — boro ghor beshi bhara.

**Validation:** share gulor jog **thik** amount-er soman hote hobe. 6000 + 4000 = 10000 ✅. Na milele `422` ar bole koto poisa gorme.

**Cheshta koro:** ekta amount `5000` kore dao — `422 "Shares total 11000.00 does not match the expense amount 10000.00"`

**Expect:** `201`

**Ki kore:** Shudhu nirbachito member-er ghare — byaktigato kenakata ba jorimana.

Statement-e eta `personalCost` field-e alada dekhabe, `allocatedFixedCost`-e na — jate member bujhte pare kon ta share ar kon ta nijer.

**Expect:** `201`

**Ki proman kore:** Blueprint-er sob cheye boro niyom code-e bandha.

Khabar soman bhag kora jabe na — je beshi kheyeche se beshi debe. Tai FOOD + EQUAL block.

**Expect:** `400` + *"FOOD expenses must be MEAL_BASED (or CUSTOM/MEMBER_SPECIFIC), never split equally"*

**Ki proman kore:** Ulto dik-eo bandha — bhara meal rate-e dhukte pare na.

Eta dhukte parle je beshi khay se beshi bhara dito, ja bhul.

**Expect:** `400` + *"MEAL_BASED allocation is only valid for FOOD expenses"*

query.description: FOOD / RENT / ELECTRICITY / GAS / WATER / INTERNET / CLEANER / MAINTENANCE / PERSONAL / OTHER
true dile void kora gulo-o ashbe

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Expense list + filter + `totalAmount`.

**Default-e void kora expense baad jay** — `includeVoided=true` dile ashbe.

**Ke parbe:** ACCOUNTANT+. Sadharon MEMBER `403` (tar jonno "My allocations" ache).

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Ek maser kharcha category-wise ar allocation-wise bhag kore dekhay.

**Kokhon lagbe:** Expense page-er upore-r summary card gulo.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Sadharon member dekhte pay **shudhu tar nijer upore chapano** angsho — sobar expense na.

**Note:** ekhane MEAL_BASED expense ashbe na, karon oita mash close-er age bhag hoy na.

**Ke parbe:** je kono member.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Ekta expense-er details + kar upore koto bhag porlo.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Expense edit kore.

**Smart behaviour:**
- amount ba allocation bodlale **share gulo notun kore hisheb hoy**
- date bodle onno mase gele expense-ta oi maser period-e chole jay
- **month closed thakle `409`** — age reopen korte hobe

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Expense ta "void" kore — **database theke mochhe na**.

**Keno:** taka-poisar record kokhono hard delete kora hoy na. Void kora row hisheb theke baad jay kintu audit-e theke jay.

**`reason` baddhotamulok** — DELETE holeo body pathate hobe.

**Expect:** `200`. Duibar chalale `409 "Expense is already voided"`

item.name: 06 · Deposits
item.description:
Member-er joma taka. Char rokom:
- `DEPOSIT` — sadharon joma (jog hoy)
- `REFUND` — ferot dewa hoyeche (**biyog hoy**)
- `ADJUSTMENT` — hisheb thik korar jonno (jog)
- `OPENING_BALANCE` — age theke jome thaka (jog)

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Kono member-er joma record kore.

`reference` — bKash/Nagad trx id rakhar jonno, pore mile dekhte kaje lage.

**Kon month-e jabe:** `transactionDate` dekhe automatic thik hoy. Oi month closed thakle `409`.

**Ke parbe:** ACCOUNTANT+. Member nije nijer deposit likhte pare na — nahole je keu bolte parto "ami 5000 diyechi".

**Expect:** `201`

exec:
pm.collectionVariables.set("depositId", pm.response.json().data.id);
try { pm.environment.set("depositId", pm.response.json().data.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }

request.description:

**Expect:** `200`

item.name: 07 · Periods & Month Close
item.description:
**Ei folder tai puro system-er hridoy.**

Sothik order:
1. `List periods` — periodId save hobe
2. `Preview` — ki hobe seta age dekho, kichu likha hobe na
3. `Close` — ek Serializable transaction-e statement toiri hoy
4. `Close again` — `409` ashbe, dwitiyo statement set hobe na
5. `Reopen` — shudhu OWNER, reason lagbe, version bare

request.description:
**⭐ Ei folder-e age eita chalao** — `periodId` auto-save hobe.

**Ki kore:** Mess-er sob mash + prati mase koyta meal/expense/deposit/statement ache.

**Expect:** `200`

exec: // Ei folder ta mash CLOSE kore. Cholti mash bandhle "05 · Expenses"
// ar "06 · Deposits" dwitiybar chalanor somoy closed mash-e likhte giye
// 409 kheto. Tai age-r ekta mash (seed-er July) beche neowa hoy —
// tate cholti mash khola thake ar puro collection barbar chalano jay.
const past = list.filter(p => p.year < y || (p.year === y && p.month < m));
const chosen = past[0] || list.find(p => p.year === y && p.month === m) || list[0];
try { pm.environment.set("periodId", chosen.id); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
// Ei mash-er ekta date — niche-r "closed month-e likha" test-e lagbe.
try { pm.environment.set("closedMonthDate", chosen.year + "-" + String(chosen.month).padStart(2, "0") + "-15"); } catch (e) { /* no environment selected */ }
console.log("periodId =", chosen.id, "(" + chosen.year + "-" + String(chosen.month).padStart(2, "0") + ") status=" + chosen.status);

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Mess ekhon kon mase ache seta dey — **mess-er timezone** dhore, server-er na.

Mash ta na thakle nijei toiri kore dey, jate 1 tarikhe member meal dite pare manager kichu na korei.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Hate kore ekta mash khole.

**Sadharonoto lage na** — meal ba expense likhle mash apnei toiri hoy. Ageye kono mash khulte chaile.

**Expect:** `201`. Already thakle `409`.

**Ki kore:** Ek maser details + count.

**Expect:** `200`

**⭐ Ei API tai sob cheye beshi guruttopurno — puro hisheb ekhane.**

**Ki kore:** Close korle **thik ja hoto** seta hisheb kore dekhay — kintu database-e **kichu likhe na**. Nirapod, joto bar khushi chalao.

**Ja dekhbe:**
- `canClose` — ekhon close kora jabe kina
- `issues[]` — `error` gulo close atkabe, `warning` gulo shudhu janay (jemon "X 3773 taka baki")
- `summary.mealRate` = totalFoodExpense ÷ totalMealUnits
- `summary.members[]` — prati member-er meal cost, fixed cost, personal cost, deposit, balance

**Nije jachai koro:** `totalGrossCost` = food + fixed + personal — **thik milte hobe**. Na milele `RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH` error dekhabe.

**Balance-er mane:** `+` mane mess tar kache dey (advance), `−` mane se mess-ke dey (due).

**Ke parbe:** ACCOUNTANT+.

**Expect:** `200`

exec: console.log("mealRate:", d.summary.mealRate, "| units:", d.summary.totalMealUnits, "| food:", d.summary.totalFoodExpense);

const rows = d.summary.members.map(m => ({ name: m.name, units: m.mealUnits, meal: m.mealCost, fixed: m.allocatedFixedCost, personal: m.personalCost, gross: m.grossCost, deposit: m.depositTotal, balance: m.closingBalance }));
// console.table exists in the Postman app but not in newman.
const food = Number(d.summary.totalFoodExpense), fixed = Number(d.summary.totalFixedCost), pers = Number(d.summary.totalPersonalCost);
pm.test("Reconciles: gross == food + fixed + personal", () => pm.expect(Number(d.summary.totalGrossCost)).to.eql(food + fixed + pers));

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Mash bondho kore ar prati member-er jonno **immutable statement** toiri kore.

**Ek Serializable transaction-e 5 dhap:** validate → aggregate → statement likha → CLOSED mark → audit.

**Keno Serializable:** duijon ek sathe close chaple duijon-i commit korte parbe na — ekjon-i jitbe. Tai duita statement set kokhono hoy na.

**Age fail hobe jodi:** kono `error` issue thake (preview-te dekha jabe) — tokhon `422` ar ki ki thik korte hobe seta `details`-e.

**Erpor:** oi maser meal/expense/deposit sob lock. Closing balance porer maser opening balance hoye jabe.

**Ke parbe:** MANAGER+ (Accountant **pare na** — se shudhu preview korte pare).

**Expect:** `200`

exec: pm.test("200 closed or 409 already closed", () => pm.expect([200, 409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; console.log("version:", d.period.calculationVersion, "| rate:", d.summary.mealRate); }

request.description:
**Ki proman kore:** Duibar close korle dwitiyo statement set toiri hoy na.

Eta blueprint-er ekta success criteria — user duibar button chaple ba network retry korle hisheb dwigun hoye jabe na.

**Erpor jachai koro:** "08 · Statements → List statements" chalao — ekhono **6ta** thakbe, 12ta na.

**Expect:** `409` + *"This month is already closed"*

**Ki proman kore:** Closed mash puropuri immutable — expense, deposit, meal kichui dhokano jabe na.

`closedMonthDate` ta "List periods" step-e auto set hoy — thik je mash-ta ekhane close kora holo, tar 15 tarikh.

**Expect:** `409` + *"This month is closed. Reopen it before changing expenses."*

**Ki kore:** Closed mash abar khole.

**Kothin niyom:**
- **shudhu OWNER** — Manager cheshta korleo `403`
- `reason` baddhotamulok (minimum 5 char)
- `calculationVersion` 1 bere jay → porer close-e **notun** statement set hobe, purono ta superseded history hisebe theke jabe
- **Order mante hobe:** ei mash-er pore kono closed mash thakle age seta reopen korte hobe (`409`) — na hole porer maser opening balance bhul hoye jabe

**Expect:** `200` + `status: "REOPENED"`, `calculationVersion: 2`

**Ki kore:** Reopen korar por je karone reopen korle seta thik kore — ekhon mash khola, tai expense dhoke.

Eta uporer "Write to CLOSED month (409)"-er ulto proman: mash khulle eki request kaj kore.

**Expect:** `201`

**Ki kore:** Thik korar por mash abar bondho kore — ebar `calculationVersion: 2`-e.

**Ja jachai korbe:**
- Notun `mealRate` — food expense bereche, tai rate-o berbe
- Purono version 1-er statement gulo **mochhe ni** — "08 · Statements → My statement history"-te dutoi version dekha jabe

**Keno version rakha hoy:** member jigges korle "ager bar amar 3773 chilo, ekhon 4100 keno" — dutoi version thakle uttor dewa jay.

**Expect:** `200` + `calculationVersion: 2`

exec: pm.test("200 closed or 409 already closed", () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; console.log("version:", d.period.calculationVersion, "| new rate:", d.summary.mealRate); }

**Expect:** `200`

**Keno version:** mash reopen hole purono hisheb-o dekha jay, tai "ager bar 3773 chilo, ekhon 4100 keno" er uttor pawa jay.

item.name: 09 · Dashboards
item.description: Tinta role-er tin rokom home screen. Sob gulo-i **provisional** — mash close na hoya porjonto rate bodlate thakbe (`isProvisional: true`).

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Ek member-er home screen-er sob number ek call-e.

**Ja pabe:** ajker meal, ei maser mot meal, cholti meal rate, onuman kora khoroch, joma, ar **onuman balance**.

**⚠️ `isProvisional: true`** — mash close na howa porjonto rate bodlabe, karon nichher bhagfol (mot meal) barte thakbe. UI-te eta "chuda-nto na" bole dekhano uchit.

**Ke parbe:** je kono member.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Puro mess-er obostha — koyjon active, ajke koyjon kheyeche, mot meal, food vs fixed kharcha, cholti rate, mot joma, ar **cash position**.

**`cashPosition`** = mot joma − mot kharcha. `+` mane mess-er hate taka ache, `−` mane kharcha beshi hoye geche.

**`openPeriods`** — kon kon mash ekhono khola, mane close korte baki.

**Ke parbe:** ACCOUNTANT+.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Randhunir screen — koyta breakfast/lunch/dinner ranna korte hobe, ar kar kar jonno.

**Bishesh:** ekhane **ekta taka-o nei**. Cook-er financial data dekhar odhikar nei, tai API-teo pathano hoy na.

**Ke parbe:** COOK+.

**Expect:** `200`

item.description: Ke, kokhon, ki bodleche — proman. Application log theke alada: eta business change-er record, debugging-er jonno na.

Expense / Deposit / MealEntry / MessPeriod / Membership / Mess

**Kokhon lagbe:** "amar meal ke bodlalo?" — `action=MEAL_OVERRIDE` diye filter koro, `reason` ar `before`/`after` dekho.

**Ke parbe:** ACCOUNTANT+. Cook/Member `403`.

**Expect:** `200`

item.name: 11 · Security & RBAC checks
item.description:
**Negative test — ekhane request fail hoya-i "pass".** Prati request-e `401`/`403`/`404` asha uchit.

Ei folder ta **nijei role bodlay** (`↪ Login as ...` request gulo), tai puro folder ekbare run kora jay. Shesh-e abar Owner-e fire ashe.

**Ekhane ja proman hoy:**
- Token chhara dhoka jay na
- Cook taka-poisa dekhte pare na
- Member onner data ba admin kaj korte pare na
- Onno mess-er data faash hoy na (404, 403 na)

request.description:
**Ki proman kore:** Token chhara protected route-e dhoka jay na.

**Ekta chalaki dorkar chilo:** login-e token **cookie-teo** jay, ar Postman cookie ta nijei rekhe dey. Tai shudhu Bearer header sorale-o cookie diye dhuke jeto ar `200` asto.

Pre-request script-e cookie jar theke `localhost`-er cookie mucha hoy, tarpor request ta jay — tokhon sotti-i kono credential thake na.

**Erpor-er request gulo** abar login kore ney, tai kichu bhange na.

**Expect:** `401` + `code: "UNAUTHENTICATED"`

exec: // Login-e token cookie-teo bosay. Cookie na mucle ei test mithye pass korto.
// pm.request.url ekhane ekhono "{{baseUrl}}/..." — resolve kore nite hobe,
// na hole jar.clear() kono domain-er sathe milbe na.

item.name: 12 · Destructive (⚠️ hate kore chalao)
item.description:
**⚠️ Ei folder ta "Run collection"-e chalio na.** Ei request gulo seed data ba tomar nijer access noshto kore dey.

Ekta ekta kore, bujhe chalao — ar ki hobe seta prati request-er description-e lekha ache.

request.description:
**Ki kore:** Password bodlay **ebong oi user-er sob active session revoke kore dey** — cookie-o clear hoy. Erpor abar login korte hobe.

**Keno session revoke:** password bodlanor mane sadharonoto "keu amar account-e dhukeche" — tai purono session beche thaka bipojjonok.

**⚠️ Ki noshto hobe:** je account-e ekhon logged in acho tar password `Messmate456` hoye jabe. Seed-er baki request gulo `Messmate123` dhore ache.

**Kibhabe ferabe:** `currentPassword: "Messmate456"`, `newPassword: "Messmate123"` diye abar chalao.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Tumi MANAGER hoye jabe ar target member OWNER hobe — **ek transaction-e**. Tai kokhono duijon owner, ba shunno owner hoy na.

**⚠️ Ki noshto hobe:** tumi ar OWNER thakbe na — reopen, role change, ownership transfer ar korte parbe na.

**Kibhabe ferabe:** notun owner-er account-e login kore ulto transfer chalao.

**Expect:** `200`

**Ki kore:** Refresh session revoke kore ar cookie clear kore.

**Note:** token bhul ba expired holeo `200` dey — logout kokhono fail kora uchit na.

**⚠️ Erpor:** abar "01 · Auth → Login — Owner" chalate hobe.

**Expect:** `200`
